measurement: close before print to close after first full session following

names.notes: Reported after close 2026-09-08: EPS $0.40 vs $0.36 consensus (beat, +11.1%), revenue $292.76M vs $285.14M consensus (beat, +2.67%, +20.9% YoY), but GTV growth decelerated ~200bps to 17% YoY. Shares gapped down hard at the open and kept falling through the session to close -29.98%, the largest magnitude break scored to date -- more than 2x the 13.14% event-implied move and far outside the panel's own 5.8-18.4% band. The Neutral / No Edge call is a clear miss (moved hard, panel had no directional view), despite the tightest panel agreement scored to date (disparity 8.7, all seven personas independently mildly bullish, certainty High). The red-team persona's own named risk to its mild-bull call -- 'if the SaaS de-rate is still mid-cycle, a good quarter gets sold anyway, exactly as it did for Salesforce and Workday this year' -- is close to exactly what happened; the mechanism was correctly identified but scored only +8 (still net positive), nowhere near enough to move the consensus off its bullish lean. The stage-2 preliminary read (+25, bullish) also called the wrong direction, missing by the same margin as the panel.

Reported before open 2026-09-09: adjusted EPS $0.36 in line, revenue $3.33B at the high end of guidance (+7.3% YoY), FY26 sales and margin guidance both raised and narrowed. Shares still gapped down ~6% at the open and extended through the session with no reversal to close -10.83%, near-exactly the 10.65% event-implied move and comfortably inside the 4.7-17.4% band. The Neutral / No Edge call is a hit under the below-expected-move convention. The red-team persona's framing -- revenue consensus already sat at the very top of management's own guide, leaving little room to surprise even on a beat-and-raise -- matches what happened; its own named upside-reversal scenario (a steady quarter plus buyback expansion squeezing a loose short base) did not fire, the mild bearish lean held instead. The stage-2 preliminary read (+16, bullish) called the wrong direction; the panel's genuine split (disparity 28.2, five of seven personas leaning down) captured the risk the single-analyst dossier missed.

Reported before open 2026-09-09: adjusted EPS $0.09 vs $0.08 consensus (beat), revenue ~$309M vs ~$310.3M consensus (slight miss), total ARR +25% YoY, SaaS ARR +36% YoY, guidance in line. Shares gapped down ~4.2% at the open but rallied intraday above the prior close before fading to close -1.18% -- a near-noise move relative to the 16.05% implied move. The stage-2 preliminary read (-18, bearish) called the direction correctly.

Reported after close 2026-09-08: EPS $0.19 vs $0.16 consensus (beat), revenue $227.2M vs $220.4M consensus (beat, +26.2% YoY), FY guidance raised -- but Q3 EPS guide missed Street, customer-add pace slowed, and FCF margin fell to 9.6% from 12.7%. Shares gapped down ~13.6% at the open and kept sliding to close -21.73%, well beyond the 14.0% implied move. The stage-2 preliminary read (-15, bearish) called the direction correctly and was the strongest single preliminary call of the run.

Reported before open 2026-09-09: adjusted EPS $2.19 vs $1.74 consensus (large beat), revenue $1.528B essentially in line (-0.5% YoY), comps +2.2%, gross margin +80bps, FY27 EPS guidance raised meaningfully ($10.45-12.15 from $9.20-11.00). Shares gapped up ~14.9% and kept climbing to close +23.96%, more than 2x the 10.0% implied move -- coverage noted the rally was amplified by a >18%-of-float short base. The stage-2 preliminary read (+18, bullish) called the direction correctly; the day's largest single-name move.

Reported before open 2026-09-09: adjusted EPS $2.31 vs $2.08 consensus (beat, +19.1% YoY), revenue $1.65B in line (+3% YoY), comps -0.4%, gross margin 40.4% helped by tariff refunds, FY EPS guidance raised above the prior top end. Shares gapped up and closed near the high, +14.40%, nearly 2x the 7.5% implied move. The stage-2 preliminary read (-12, bearish) called the wrong direction -- the one preliminary miss of the run on an otherwise straightforward beat-and-raise.
